Nick joins Capt. Dave DeGenaro as lightning quick bonito invade New Jersey waters for fast-paced, reel-burning action on light tackle.

title: Unfathomed
description:
S08 E07 — Mullet Run
Follow Capt. George in search of fish and adventure.

title: The Fish Guyz
description:
S07 E01 — Grocery Shopping
Captains Lain and Chris head out on a busman's holiday with a surprise guest and find an on-fire snapper bite. The Guys visit the Marathon Wild Bird Center. Chef Cat prepares perfect fish sliders.

title: Spear Life
description:
S07 E04 — On the Hunt for Giant Hogfish
The Spear Life crew embarks on a multi-day offshore adventure from Clearwater to the legendary Florida Middle Grounds, targeting giant hogfish, grouper and snapper while diving historic wrecks and battling sharks along the way.

title: Gale Force Twins
description:
S01 E04 — Guatemala Twins Billfishing
Identical twins Amanda and Emily Gale travel to Central America where giant billfish leap towards the sky with every cast.
